system.boundary: Build a causal two-body axisymmetric point-absorber wave-energy converter.
engineering_objects: Build a causal two-body axisymmetric point-absorber wave-energy converter.
A surface float and a submerged spar/plate must each have rigid-body heave dynamics and physically connected hydrodynamic excitation, radiation, added-mass and hydrostatic-restoring effects.
Couple the two bodies through a translational power-take-off (PTO) so that its force acts on their relative heave motion and its absorbed power is calculated from that same force/velocity path.
